name: Sacred Orders
worldbuilding: Military religious orders, fortress-monasteries, holy knights, warrior-priests, and sacred guardians. Their warriors are unusually disciplined, but their armies are smaller and more expensive than conventional forces.

factionRule.name: Unyielding
factionRule.effect: All friendly Sacred Orders Units gain Tough 1. This combines with other applicable sources of Tough X, following the normal rules for ranked keywords; no Armor Save die may be rerolled more than once.
factionRule.playtestNote: Replaces the former once-per-Round first-Damage reduction. Applies to all friendly Units, not only Core, Elite or Armored.

factionCommands.name: Stand Fast
factionCommands.effect: Improve one friendly Unit's Armor or an applicable Ward by one step until the end of the Phase.

factionCommands.name: Righteous Retaliation
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: After a friendly Unit survives a Melee Attack, it gains +3 Attack dice on its next eligible Melee Attack against the attacker. This bonus expires at the end of the following Round if unused; it applies once to the combined Attack pool, not per Model.

factionCommands.name: Heroic Intervention
factionCommands.effect: When a friendly Unit is targeted by an Attack, choose a different friendly Unit within Short of the attacked Unit. The chosen Unit may immediately Move up to 3" toward the attacked Unit, ending legally. It cannot use this Move as a free Disengage, and this does not change the declared Attack target or intercept the Attack.

factionCommands.name: Break Their Line
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Elite 4 or Anti-Cavalry 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

signatureCoreNote: Three Core choices are retained as a deliberate elite-army exception.

abilities.name: Steadfast
abilities.effect: Gain Tough 1 while holding an objective.

abilities.name: Exorcist Ammunition
abilities.effect: This Unit gains Anti-Undead 2 on its eligible Attacks. Apply the bonus once to the combined Unit Attack pool, not once per Model; only the highest applicable Anti rank applies.

abilities.name: Suppressing Bolts
abilities.effect: If this Unit inflicts unsaved Damage with its next Relic Crossbows Attack this Assault Phase, the target suffers Slow 2 until after its next Movement activation.

abilities.name: Hallowed Charge
abilities.effect: After this Unit successfully Charges, gain Ward 6+ or improve its applicable existing Ward by one step until the end of the Round.

abilities.name: Zealous Hunters
abilities.effect: This Unit gains Anti-Elite 2 on its eligible Attacks. Apply the bonus once to the combined Unit Attack pool, not once per Model; only the highest applicable Anti rank applies.

abilities.name: Hold the Breach
abilities.effect: Choose one friendly Infantry Unit within Short. Until the end of the Round, enemy abilities cannot force that Unit to Disengage or reposition.

abilities.name: Benediction
abilities.effect: Improve one nearby Unit's applicable Ward by one step until the end of the Phase.

abilities.name: Laying Hands
abilities.effect: Target one unit within Short of this unit. Heal 2 that unit.

abilities.name: Anti-Undead 2 Training
abilities.effect: This Unit gains Anti-Undead 2 on its eligible Weapon and Spell Attacks; add the bonus once to the combined Attack pool, not per Model.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Sever the Unholy
abilities.effect: Choose one visible enemy within Medium. Until the end of the Phase, it cannot Heal or return defeated Models.

abilities.name: Consecrated Presence
abilities.effect: Friendly Units within Short gain Ward 6+ against Magic Attacks or their Ward is improved by 1 against magic.

abilities.name: Processional Ward
abilities.effect: One friendly Unit within Short may reroll natural 1s on a Ward Save.

abilities.name: Inspiring Presence
abilities.effect: Friendly Units within Short cannot be forced to Disengage by enemy abilities.

abilities.name: Miracle of Deliverance
abilities.effect: After objectives are scored, return up to one defeated basic Model to each of up to three surviving, unengaged friendly Units within Medium, up to their starting sizes. Remove one temporary negative condition from each chosen Unit.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Cheap objective-holding Infantry, ordinary Crossbowmen, Field Medics, and generic Heavy Cavalry. The Sacred Orders' specialized troops are powerful but expensive.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: Sacred Orders already had its three-Core advantage and did not receive an Extra Core (see factions/index.json and campaign note). Damage-1 weapons across the faction gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Elite on Consecrated Knights' Blessed Lances, Anti-Infernal on the Living Saint's Sacred Blade) or an improved Hit (Trample 4+ -> 3+).
